summary: Pin libmpv's Mach-O export list to the 54 public mpv_* symbols, scoped to the libmpv link only.
asymmetry: darwin-only BY MECHANISM, not by need. The Android fork solves the same problem — keeping the static archives' symbols out of libmpv's export table — with BUILD FLAGS rather than a patch: buildscripts/scripts/mpv.sh passes -Wl,--version-script=include/mpv.ver and -Wl,--exclude-libs=ALL. There is deliberately no Android counterpart to this file. The two export lists live side by side in rn-media-engine assets/export-lists/ (mpv.ver: wildcard mpv_*, 55 exported; mpv.exp: 54 exact names) and the 55-vs-54 delta is mpv_lavc_set_java_vm, added by 001-lavc-set-java-vm.
markersNote: The effect IS the export table, so there is nothing to grep: asserted by the exports and export-purity categories, which compare the shipped symbol set against assets/export-lists/mpv.exp.
